name: linkto-no-kick
summary: A same-zone link (GM &linkto, a gate, a scroll) whose destination has no standable spot DISCONNECTS the player (error 1669). Make it a no-op instead: the exe already restores the old position right after the kick.
status: BUILT 2026-09-23 from the wire + asm below; boot on one zone, then everywhere (operator rule).
why: Operator, 2026-09-22: '&linkto FroTundra 3200 3200' got the character kicked. Reproduced on the stack with a
bot (Fiesta2026on2016 tickets.md): 24 ms after the chat command the zone sends NC_USER_CONNECTCUT_CMD err
0x0685 (1669). The same command to a WALKABLE spot works, the same blocked spot reached from ANOTHER zone
(LINKOTHER) lands you at the map's spawn point - only the same-zone path kicks. (3200,3200) on FroTundra is
a blocked tile with nothing standable for 450 units; Valtara (6000,6000) kicks the same way.
ShinePlayer::so_LinkTo (0x49AD30, vtable slot 384), same-zone branch:
0x49B1A5   [player.pos] = link->coordx / coordy        ; the new position, written first
0x49B1C3   call vtable+0x4C0                           ; sector update
0x49B1D2   call ShineObject::so_MapMarking(0)          ; 0x466470 -> FieldMap::fm_Marking
0x49B1D7   test eax, eax                               ; FM_MarkingError: 0 = placed
0x49B1D9   je   0x49B225                               ; placed: send LINKSAME, return 1
0x49B1DB   mov  edx, [ebx]                             ; <-- not placed:
0x49B1DD   mov  eax, [edx+0x5F8]                       ;     vtable slot 382 = ShinePlayer::so_Disconnect (0x54F340)
0x49B1E3   push 0 / push 0 / push 0x685                ;     so_Disconnect(1669, RemoveWhen 0, 0)
0x49B1EC   mov  ecx, ebx / call eax                    ;     the kick
0x49B1F0   mov  eax, [ebp-0x2C] ...                    ; restore the OLD position and re-mark it
0x49B220   jmp  0x49AE61                               ; return 0 (the 'link did not happen' value)
fm_Marking (0x452FD0) with force=0 first tries the exact spot, then up to 32 candidate spots around it
(the search that turned Valtara (100,100) into (125,100) on the cross-zone path); when none is free it
returns an error and so_LinkTo answers with the disconnect. Every caller of so_LinkTo takes the 0 return as
'no link' already (ac_LinkTo ignores it; the gate menu and the scroll do nothing more), so the kick adds
nothing but the disconnect itself.
THE PATCH: the two bytes at 0x49B1DB (8B 13, mov edx,[ebx]) become EB 13 (jmp short +0x13 -> 0x49B1F0):
the disconnect is skipped and execution lands on the exe's own restore of the old position, then the
normal return 0. Nothing is sent to the client. The 19 bytes between are dead code.
The zonehook quest_gate plugin wraps so_LinkTo and, when the original returns 0 for a link it let
through, logs 'link to <map> (<x>,<y>) did not happen' and sends the player a notice - so a GM sees why
&linkto did nothing instead of being disconnected.
HOW TO PROVE IT: as GM on FroTundra, '&linkto FroTundra 3200 3200' - stock: CONNECTCUT 1669 and a relog;
patched: nothing on the wire but the notice, the character stays where it was.

edits.why: so_LinkTo: skip the so_Disconnect(0x685) when the destination cannot be marked; fall into the position restore
